checks.name: Actual delayed HTTP download stages rows without mutating active table
Production tick releases the actual control tail while HTTP is still pending
Consecutive ticks do not duplicate an in-flight poll
At most two real HTTP downloads run concurrently and later due tables are reached
Scope changed during HTTP read refuses the late result
Removed table wins over late staged HTTP data
Reconfigured table wins over late staged HTTP data
New binding wins over late staged HTTP data
New row selection wins over late staged HTTP data
Same ID replacement wins over late staged HTTP data
HTTP error retains rows and applies a bounded retry timestamp
Failed persistence rolls staged rows back and never authorizes automatic publication
Automatic publication executes only in the serial tail after accepted rows

limits: HTTP server and file persistence are real own resources
Production.tick is the actual product method; Native refresh/audio/observers are explicit fixtures
No Native, operator, external URL, output or audio device accessed
Manual explicit data configuration/refresh remains serialized; this fix concerns periodic polling
This is not a desktop latency, GPU, CEF or Native playback measurement
